title: puccinellia angustata
intro: Puccinellia angustata, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Saltwort or Salt Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Puccinellia angustata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
